baseline.method: analytic normal model (lineup-0.2.0): my matchup-aware lineup vs the opponent's generic best-players lineup

adds.note: a waiver claim counts against the week in which it is processed; each pair's adds_needed counts the stream add and the follow-up chain claim (this week / next week)

week_only.why: this week's ΔP(win) beyond noise; season effect not resolved (within ±2 SE)
this week's ΔP(win) beyond noise; season effect not resolved (within ±2 SE)

decision_rule: recommend a pair only if its season stream chain (streamer for the stint, then the 6-th best realistic free agent) has ΔP(playoffs) or ΔP(title) > 2 paired SE and neither < -2 SE under every projection set, and the stream is not < -2 SE vs the direct move (the season sim includes this week); otherwise recommend nothing. Pairs whose only significant gain is this week's ΔP(win) are listed in week_only with the season ΔP(title) lower bound, for the user to weigh. Every add/drop needs approval.

labels.week_*: model: lineup-0.2.0 analytic normal matchup model (fitted game noise and projection error; availability priors: rest_share, injury-tag priors); week_mc = its paired Monte Carlo (simulated)
labels.season: simulated: position-aware season sim (season-sim, PositionAwareSimulator), paired, 2000 sims, seed 0; the stream CHAIN: streamer for his stint only, then the (chain_k+1)-th best realistic free agent (fa0 / fa{k} / replacement level reported); direct = drop -> chain FA with no stream; ± = Monte Carlo SE only (excludes projection/model error); other teams never add/drop
labels.chain_k: PRIOR: other teams claim the best free agents first
labels.projection_sets: blend and market share OUR fitted availability model (games played); the stress set (espn-only-gp) uses ESPN's per-game stats AND ESPN's games (known ~+11 games/player optimistic), so it is the only set independent of our availability model. When the blend is in-season but the stress file was built from the PRESEASON base, it is renamed 'stress_preseason' and reported as a sensitivity only: it never votes in 'helps under every set' (it would mix preseason injuries/roles with current ones)
labels.season_proxy_d_value: valuation value(add) - value(drop): season G-score totals (screen only)
labels.effective: ASSUMPTION: free agent plays from today; waiver claim from its date + --waiver-lag; the claim may lose to a team higher in the rolling waiver order
